# Keyboard shortcuts

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/gen-shortcuts.mjs from the command registry. Do not edit by hand: run `npm run docs:shortcuts`. -->

Every toolbar button, menu entry, context-menu item, keyboard shortcut and the command palette (`Ctrl/Cmd+K`) call the same
command registry, so this list is exactly what the in-app dialog (`?` or `F1`) shows. `Mod` is `Cmd` on macOS and `Ctrl` elsewhere.
A few commands share a key and apply in different situations (for example `Enter` edits the selected element, or enters a table's cell mode);
the app runs the first one that is enabled for the current selection.

## File

| Command | Windows / Linux | macOS | Command id |
|---|---|---|---|
| Export diagram | `Ctrl+Shift+E` | `⇧⌘E` | `file.export` |
| Open project file | `Ctrl+O` | `⌘O` | `file.open` |
| Save project file | `Ctrl+S` | `⌘S` | `file.save` |

## Edit

| Command | Windows / Linux | macOS | Command id |
|---|---|---|---|
| Copy | `Ctrl+C` | `⌘C` | `edit.copy` |
| Cut | `Ctrl+X` | `⌘X` | `edit.cut` |
| Delete | `Del` or `Backspace` | `⌦` or `⌫` | `edit.delete` |
| Deselect | `Ctrl+Shift+A` | `⇧⌘A` | `edit.deselect` |
| Duplicate | `Ctrl+D` | `⌘D` | `edit.duplicate` |
| Paste | `Ctrl+V` | `⌘V` | `edit.paste` |
| Redo | `Ctrl+Shift+Z` or `Ctrl+Y` | `⇧⌘Z` or `⌘Y` | `edit.redo` |
| Select all | `Ctrl+A` | `⌘A` | `edit.selectAll` |
| Undo | `Ctrl+Z` | `⌘Z` | `edit.undo` |

## Tools and settings

| Command | Windows / Linux | macOS | Command id |
|---|---|---|---|
| Leave cell mode | `Esc` | `Esc` | `cell.exit` |
| Extend column selection to the right | `Shift+Right` | `⇧→` | `cell.extendNext` |
| Extend column selection to the left | `Shift+Left` | `⇧←` | `cell.extendPrev` |
| First column | `Home` | `Home` | `cell.first` |
| Last column | `End` | `End` | `cell.last` |
| Next column | `Right` | `→` | `cell.next` |
| Previous column | `Left` | `←` | `cell.prev` |
| Rename column | `F2` | `F2` | `cell.rename` |
| Mark or unmark column | `Space` | `Space` | `cell.toggle` |
| Add attribute | `A` | `A` | `chen.addAttribute` |
| Connect selected shape to another (arrow keys, Enter) | `L` | `L` | `chen.linkFromSelection` |
| New entity at the view centre | `E` | `E` | `chen.newEntity` |
| New relationship at the view centre | `Shift+R` | `⇧R` | `chen.newRelationship` |
| Add bend on the focused segment | `I` | `I` | `edge.insertBend` |
| Next connector handle | `]` | `]` | `edge.nextBend` |
| Move the focused connector handle | `Left` or `Right` or `Up` or `Down` | `←` or `→` or `↑` or `↓` | `edge.nudgeHandle` |
| Previous connector handle | `[` | `[` | `edge.prevBend` |
| Create foreign key from this column | `Shift+F` | `⇧F` | `fk.fromSelection` |
| Command palette | `Ctrl+K` | `⌘K` | `palette.open` |
| Settings | `Ctrl+,` | `⌘,` | `settings` |
| Move between columns with the keyboard (cell mode) | `Enter` | `↩` | `table.cellMode` |
| New table at the view centre | `T` | `T` | `table.new` |
| Connect tool | `C` | `C` | `tool.connect` |
| Foreign key tool | `F` | `F` | `tool.fk` |
| Hand tool | `H` | `H` | `tool.hand` |
| Select tool | `V` | `V` | `tool.select` |

## View

| Command | Windows / Linux | macOS | Command id |
|---|---|---|---|
| Move focus to the next region (canvas, properties, library) | `F6` | `F6` | `focus.next` |
| Move focus to the previous region | `Shift+F6` | `⇧F6` | `focus.prev` |
| Move focus to the Properties panel | `Ctrl+Alt+P` | `⌥⌘P` | `focus.properties` |
| Fit to content | `Shift+1` | `⇧1` | `view.fit` |
| Fit selection | `Shift+2` | `⇧2` | `view.fitSelection` |
| Show grid | `Ctrl+'` | `⌘'` | `view.toggleGrid` |
| Show issues | `Ctrl+J` | `⌘J` | `view.togglePanel.issues` |
| Show parts library | `Ctrl+B` | `⌘B` | `view.togglePanel.library` |
| Show properties | `Ctrl+I` | `⌘I` | `view.togglePanel.properties` |
| Zoom in | `Ctrl+=` or `Ctrl++` | `⌘=` or `⌘+` | `view.zoomIn` |
| Zoom out | `Ctrl+-` | `⌘-` | `view.zoomOut` |
| Actual size | `Ctrl+0` | `⌘0` | `view.zoomReset` |
